Lead source: inbound, self-serve signup. Early stage SMB; product team building in-app support assistant using Hosted API streaming + function/tool-calling. Key pain: when using JSON mode + streaming they see intermittent client-side JSON.parse errors — root cause appears to be streaming partial output chunks that the web client attempts to parse mid-stream. Also encountering function schema mismatch between backend ticketing API (snake_case) and front-end schema (camelCase) which causes Redwood function call validation to return unexpected 'missing required parameter' responses. Customer uses React web client, Axios SSE-handling code; said quote: "Works in local tests but fails under load/long responses."

What we tried: reproduced locally with their sample convo, advised use of 'json_mode: object' (server-side) and explicit message separators on stream; suggested schema canonicalization and use of explicit 'required' fields to avoid omission of nulls. SE session created sample wrappers: streaming buffer + incremental JSON assembler in client, server-side shim to normalize snake<->camel. Shared drive docs: JSON function schema templates and minimal SSE client examples.

Risk/objections: cost sensitivity (watching token usage on streaming); wants assurance that streaming + tool-calling in Hosted API is stable for production. Security ask: SSO for admin console + audit logs to show function call activity.

Quote from CTO during call: "We signed up because API was simple — but this integration detail is blocking our QA run."

Next tacticals: 1) 30m follow-up to demo a working streaming + fn-call flow with their sample ticketing schema, 2) provide a short JS client snippet that reassembles JSON from stream safely, 3) include recommended retry/fallback policy suggestions and estimated token delta for streaming vs polling, 4) open a short POC with 1-week elevated trial if they validate integration.
